newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Hargraves lifts gold output to 70,000/oz.
newsitem.headline: Hargraves lifts gold output to 70,000/oz.

text.p: Hargraves Resources NL said on Thursday it expected mill improvements at its Browns Creek mine in New South Wales to increase annual production to 70,000 ounces of gold a year from a current 50,000.

"The mill upgrade at Browns Creek Mine is complete and the mine is now operating at the rate of 370,000 tonnes of ore per annum, compared with the previous 270,000 tonnes per annum," Hargraves said. "This will enable gold production of 70,000 ounces per annum compared with the previous 50,000 ounces."
Hargraves also said it had decided to accelerate testing of the nearby Bald Hills intrusive-related gold-copper prospect.
Three diamond drilling rigs were currently employed in testing a central zone of mineralisation, the company said.
Further drilling would then be carried out to test other targets in the prospect area, the company said.
The miner said it expected to spend about A$7 million on exploration in the next nine months.
